C 4.0 · FOUNDATION CUT
F 0.0 · PAINT DRY

We call 811 before the bucket touches dirt

Every utility line gets marked with paint. We hand-dig near the flags so you never pay for a hit gas or water main. If your ZIP is in our area, we can usually get marks within three business days.

C 2.4 → F 1.2

Seven steps from stake to seed

You see what happens in your yard each day. No hole left open, no mud pit when we leave.

01 · STAKE

Batter Board boards set

We stake every corner and run string at finished grade so you can walk the footprint before we dig.

02 · LOCATE

Paint on the ground

811 marks every buried line. We hand-dig within two feet of any flag.

03 · CUT

Foundation or trench opened

Bucket teeth in rocky clay, walls kept plumb, spoil piled where it won't rut the lawn.

04 · SET

Footing forms or pipe bed

Base compacted to spec so the builder's forms sit level or the pipe has fall.

05 · BACKFILL

Lifts, not one dump

Fill goes back in six-inch lifts, each one packed. That's how settling stops.

06 · GRADE

Rain runs away

Final slope falls at least five percent for ten feet from the foundation.

07 · SEED

Straw and seed down

Bare ground gets covered before we leave. The job is closed, not abandoned.

0.0 · ON GRADE

What we dig

Basement and foundation digs

Staked, dug to depth with room for footing forms, then backfilled in compacted layers.

Trenching

Straight, even trenches for pipe or conduit, with the sod set aside and put back.

Backhoe work by the hour

A backhoe and operator for stumps, rocks, footings or small digs, billed by the hour.

Yard and site grading

Ground shaped so rain runs away from the house, finished with straw and seed.

Water and power line trenches

Trenches dug below frost depth for water, power or shop conduit, after the locate paint.

French drains

Perforated pipe in clean rock and fabric that carries wet-yard water out to daylight.

Retaining wall prep

Cut back, leveled and compacted base so the wall builder starts on solid ground.

Rock and chert removal

Ledge rock and chert broken out and hauled off, priced before we start.

Wooded Springfield lot mid-dig — residential scale, no highway iron.

0.0 · SAMPLE RANGE

Sample prices, not promises

Every number below comes from past jobs in Springfield. Your site may differ — rock, access and distance all move the range.

JobRangeNote
Backhoe and operator Sample $95 – $140 2-hour minimum, travel included in town
Utility trench Sample $8 – $18 rock not included
French drain Sample $2,800 – $7,500 most 60-150 ft runs
Yard regrade Sample $1,800 – $6,000 with straw and seed
Basement dig and backfill Sample $9,000 – $22,000 rock priced separately

Backhoe hourly includes operator and fuel. Trench footage assumes soft dig; rock billed separately.
